description: Tarquin-owned LEG shared surface for Arrow import/check. This artifact is a build-time contract, not a runtime dependency.

canonical_field_4.notes: The wire shape and codes are unchanged for v0.1. New prose should use Action; Policy remains a compatibility alias for current Arrow field/type names.

class_terminology.notes: Class 4 is a control-plane event class, not the Action field and not Origin PCY.

origins.name: policy_governance_origin
origins.notes: PCY remains the governance/policy source domain. It is not renamed by the Action transition.

actions.name: trigger
actions.notes: Trigger semantics are scoped by RFC-009. Do not treat TR as generic PR or as proof of transfer by itself.

actions.name: closed
actions.notes: Closed semantics are scoped by RFC-009. Class 6 pairing and finality/reversal behavior remain unresolved.

policy_alias.notes: Retained for Arrow compatibility while field 4 migrates from Policy to Action.

policies.name: trigger
policies.notes: Legacy Policy alias for Action TR.

policies.name: closed
policies.notes: Legacy Policy alias for Action CL.

states.name: timelocked
states.notes: TL is a State value only. It is not an Action/Policy code.

verification_regimes.notes: Manual or institutionally reviewed legal attestation fallback.
Single Sibyl/LBRY structured proof path. B requires verified LBRY signature under OA-014.
Independent multi-Sibyl evidence path. Tier-3 remains SO-001 gated.

confidence.notes: A is reserved for a future legal-native regime. B is a ceiling, not a default.

leg_007.matrix_shape: leg_subtype x Finality x verification_regime -> permitted Action set
leg_007.legacy_matrix_shape: leg_subtype x Finality x verification_regime -> permitted Policy set
leg_007.gate: Real on-chain PR remains unavailable until the LEG-007 derivation matrix is complete and imported by Arrow.

minimal_common_denominator.notes: Restriction/review/cure family. AssetFreeze can derive from HL plus scope/duration metadata or BL for hard block.
Authorization/proceed family after full conjunctive gate and human ratification.

uncovered_actions.notes: TR should not be treated as generic PR. RFC-009 scopes whether it triggers a workflow, transfer class event, or both.
CL terminal/lifecycle semantics and Class 6 pairing are unresolved under RFC-009.

primitive_bindings.notes: Stub; concrete deployment supplies ratifier authorization and execution effect.

arrow_import_contract.ci_expectation: Arrow fails CI if checked-in generated validation fixtures drift from this artifact or if the pinned hash changes without review.
